messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need a concise traffic-light for the release tomorrow. I pulled a minimal gate list: SLA doc, pricing table, billing smoke, runbooks, monitoring alerts, oncall rota. Who can own which? :eyes:
Devon: I can take SLA doc + oncall rota. Will post PR by EOD.
Matt: I'll do pricing table and billing smoke run. Ping me if you have customer-specific overrides.
Sophia: Monitoring alerts + runbooks. Need to confirm the three key metrics: tail latency p95, token cost per request, error rate.
Lydia: ops-bot will run the smoke tests after Matt updates the pricing flags. I'll review runbooks.
Matt: pricing flags are in `pricing/config.yaml` — added new tiers for dedicated capacity. Quick snippet:
```
tiers:
  - name: reserved
    commit_months: 12
    discount_pct: 30
```
Matt: billing smoke plan: create a synthetic tenant, run 1k requests, verify invoice event emitted and cost matches expected rounding.
Devon: SLA doc draft is at https://docs.internal/sla/dedicated-beta — added escalation ladder and SLOs (99.9 uptime, 200ms p50, 750ms p95). Please review.
Sophia: Alerts: suggest alert thresholds -> p95 > 900ms (P0), error_rate > 0.5% (P0), queue_length > 50 (P1). Also enable burn-in trace sampling for first 24h.
Anya: Good. Two operational asks: (1) confirm runbook for partial fallback to smaller model variant, (2) confirm cost-override knob for pilot customers.
Lydia: Runbook for fallback is in PR #412. Includes commands and `curl` snippets. Example quick rollback command in runbook:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.redwood/api/v1/rollout -d '{"strategy":"fallback-small"}'
```
Lydia: I'll add a short checklist to the runbook for oncall.
Matt: Cost-override knob exists as `pilot_override` in billing service; will add docs link to pricing table.
Devon: Ops-bot: please schedule smoke job at 04:45 UTC and post results here when done.
ops-bot: scheduled smoke job `pricing-billing-smoke-173765` for 2025-03-12T04:45:00Z. Will report pass/fail.
Sophia: One documentation note: SDK examples need a small update for streaming responses to show graceful degradation when fallback triggers. I'll submit a tiny PR.
Anya: Thanks — owners summary: Devon -> SLA + oncall rota, Matt -> pricing + billing smoke, Sophia -> monitoring + runbooks update + SDK snippet, Lydia -> runbook checklist + validate fallback commands. I will own launch checklist and confirmation message to legal/commercial.
Devon: Confirmed. ETA for PRs: 5pm PT.
Matt: I'll run the local smoke by 03:30 UTC and post results before ops-bot run.
ops-bot: pricing-billing-smoke-173765 completed: PASS. invoice_event_count=1 expected=1. cost_delta=0.0. Logs: https://logs.redwood/smoke/173765
Anya: Excellent. Last question: do we have a documented pricing FAQ for pilot customers (refunds/overages)? Commercial needs that before launch.
Matt: I'll draft a short FAQ and drop into the pricing doc.
Lydia: Runbook checklist added. Oncall rota updated.
Anya: OK — green for go if all PRs land by 5pm PT. If anything slips, mark amber and escalate to the shiproom. :shipit:
Sophia: Noted. I'll bump if monitoring alerts need tuning after burn-in.
Devon: I'll merge SLA PR once folks review.
Anya: Thanks team — I'll post final status at 17:15 PT in #all-hands and ping commercial/legal.
